User guide · Formats · Platform support

Rowlight's maintained platforms are Linux x64 and Windows x64. Download 0.1.0-alpha.1, or choose a version from the Releases page and expand Assets. Alpha releases are marked Pre-release. You do not need Rust to run a downloaded build. GitHub's automatic Source code archives are for building the project, not installing the application.

Choose a download

Platform Download Use
Omarchy / Arch x64 rowlight-bin-PKGVER-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst Recommended; install with pacman
Other Linux x64 rowlight-VERSION-linux-x64-cloud.tar.gz Extract, then run or install
Windows x64 rowlight-VERSION-windows-x64-cloud-setup.exe Recommended; per-user installation
Windows x64 rowlight-VERSION-windows-x64-cloud.zip Portable use

VERSION is the release version, for example 0.1.0-alpha.1; the Arch package's PKGVER uses dots, for example 0.1.0.alpha.1. Download the matching SHA256SUMS file as well. Installation steps are below: Omarchy / Arch · Other Linux · Windows.

Core or cloud

The cloud download includes local Parquet, Arrow IPC / Feather v2, CSV and TSV, plus remote Parquet from S3, Azure, GCS and HTTP(S). Local-only core packages can also be built from source; they omit -cloud in their filenames.

The alpha is unsigned. Windows may show an unrecognized-publisher warning. Verify the download against the release's SHA256SUMS:

# Linux: run beside the downloaded archive and SHA256SUMS
sha256sum --ignore-missing --check SHA256SUMS

# Windows: compare the hash with the corresponding line in SHA256SUMS
Get-FileHash .\rowlight-VERSION-windows-x64-cloud-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256

Expect OK on Linux or an identical hash on Windows. If verification fails, download the file again before installing. Checksums detect damaged or changed downloads; they do not verify the publisher's identity. See Microsoft's signing guidance.

Note: The executable remains parquetviewer / parquetviewer.exe. Existing settings and application identifiers are preserved for compatibility. The visible app name is Rowlight; legacy Windows registrations may still say Parquet Viewer.

Omarchy / Arch

Download the .pkg.tar.zst file and SHA256SUMS from the same release, then verify the package using the Linux checksum command above. From that folder, run:

sudo pacman -U ./rowlight-bin-0.1.0.alpha.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst

Pacman installs the executable, desktop entry, MIME types, icon and licenses, and resolves the declared dependencies. Open Rowlight from the application menu. The package registers Open With support without writing a new default-app choice. Use the first-launch offer to opt in to making Rowlight the Parquet default.

To update, download the newer package and use pacman -U again. Remove it with sudo pacman -R rowlight-bin; preferences are kept. A working Vulkan driver is required. Follow Omarchy's normal update process for system updates.

An AUR listing is not available yet. Until it is published, updates require downloading the next release; yay -S rowlight-bin is not an installation option. The package recipe is prepared for a future AUR maintainer.

If you previously used the per-user archive installer, run its uninstall script before switching to the Arch package. An old launcher or binary in ~/.local can take precedence over the package-managed installation. Your settings remain.

Other Linux

Requires glibc 2.39 or later, a graphical Wayland or X11 session, and a Vulkan driver. Official archives are built on Ubuntu 24.04. Installation also needs xdg-mime, update-mime-database and update-desktop-database (on Ubuntu, xdg-utils, shared-mime-info and desktop-file-utils).

  1. Download the Linux archive and verify its checksum.
  2. Extract it using your file manager, or run the following in your Downloads folder, replacing VERSION with the downloaded version:

sh tar -xzf rowlight-VERSION-linux-x64-cloud.tar.gz cd rowlight-VERSION-linux-x64-cloud ./scripts/install-linux.sh

  1. Open Rowlight from the application menu, then choose Open file.

Installation does not require administrator privileges. Launch Rowlight from the application menu or ~/.local/bin/parquetviewer. License notices are installed under your XDG data directory in parquetviewer/.

For portable use, skip the installer and run ./parquetviewer from the extracted folder. To open a file directly, run ./parquetviewer "/path/to/file.parquet". To update an installation, extract the new release and run its installer again. Your preferences and existing file defaults are preserved.

Registration preserves existing defaults. Accept the first-launch association offer, or use Associate Parquet files… from the menu, to opt in to changing Parquet's default. No thanks remembers your choice.

The previous default is recorded in ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/parquetviewer/previous-default. Restore it with xdg-mime default PREVIOUS.desktop application/vnd.apache.parquet application/x-parquet, replacing PREVIOUS.desktop with that saved value.

To remove the per-user installation, run this from an extracted Rowlight archive:

./scripts/uninstall-linux.sh

It removes the installed executable, registration and license files. Preferences are kept. If Rowlight was the Parquet default and the installer recorded an older default, that choice is restored. Other defaults are left alone.

Windows

Requires Windows 10 or later, x64, with a DirectX 11 graphics driver.

  1. Download rowlight-VERSION-windows-x64-cloud-setup.exe and verify its checksum.
  2. Double-click the installer and follow its steps. It installs for your Windows account without an administrator prompt, adds Rowlight to Start, and registers it under Open with.
  3. Open Rowlight from Start, then choose Open file.

The first alpha is unsigned. Windows security settings may warn about an unknown publisher or block it; a checksum does not replace a trusted signature.

For portable use, right-click the ZIP, choose Extract All, and run parquetviewer.exe from the extracted folder. Keep the extracted files together; the ZIP does not include an installer or add a Start menu entry.

To update an installation, run the newer setup executable. It retains your preferences and existing file defaults. For a portable update, close the app and extract the new ZIP into a new folder.

To make double-click open Parquet, use Choose in Windows Settings in the first-launch offer or Associate Parquet files… from the menu. Choose Rowlight for .parquet and .parq in Default Apps. On Windows 10, choose defaults by file type. You can also right-click a file → Open with → Choose another app → Always. Windows owns the final default selection; installation does not replace it.

Uninstall through Settings → Apps → Installed apps → Rowlight → Uninstall (Apps & features on Windows 10). It removes the app's registrations and keeps preferences. On upgrades, the original Programs\Parquet Viewer installation directory is retained.

Try from source

Install Rust with rustup and the native prerequisites. The checkout pins Rust 1.99.0 and Cargo.lock. Use the fast development preview:

cargo dev -- /path/to/file.parquet

Source saves rebuild and restart the preview. Its settings are separate from the installed app, and it skips the association prompt. Close the preview or press Ctrl+C to stop. Quote paths containing spaces.

For packages, use ./scripts/package-linux-container.sh --cloud on Linux with Docker, or ./scripts/package-windows.ps1 -Cloud in a native Windows MSVC/SDK environment with Inno Setup 6. The Linux container has a separate retained cache; it does not replace the host development cache. See release preparation.

macOS

macOS is experimental community tooling, outside the official release matrix. There are no official Mac downloads or native test guarantees. Existing source and native scripts/package-macos.sh / scripts/install-macos.sh tooling remain available for contributors with Mac hardware. Read platform support before relying on them.

Preferences remain in the existing parquetviewer user configuration directory; see saved settings.
